Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 51

“The wise, endowed with this understanding, abandoning the fruits born of action and freed from the bondage of birth, reach the state beyond all ills.”

Krishna states the destination in negative terms — a place beyond ills rather than a described paradise. Consistent with a teaching that keeps refusing to make its goal one more prize to chase.
